events.title: Alex McLeish , manager of Scottish football club 레인저스 announced the signing of seventeen-year-old Turkish player Yardis Alpolfo in a £5 million deal. The name is in fact an anagram of "April Fool's Day" but many news sources, including Reuters , reported the story.

맨체스터 유나이티드 seize the initiative in the title challenge by beating 리버풀 4–0 at Old Trafford as 아스널 can only manage a 1–1 draw at 애스턴 빌라. 리즈 유나이티드 move closer to survival with a 6–1 away win over a Charlton side which effectively ends their opposition's hopes of European qualification.

폴 스콜스 scores a hat-trick as 맨체스터 유나이티드 beat 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 6–2 on Tyneside to extend their lead at the top of the Premier League. 뉴캐슬 유나이티드's neighbours 선덜랜드's relegation is confirmed by a 2–0 defeat at 버밍엄 시티.

The much-anticipated "title decider" between 아스널 and 맨체스터 유나이티드 at Highbury ends in a 2–2 draw, meaning that 아스널 are now three points behind 맨체스터 유나이티드 but with a game in hand and a remotely superior goal difference.

폴 스콜스 is on the scoresheet twice as a 3–1 home win over 블랙번 로버스 edges 맨체스터 유나이티드 closer to their eighth Premier League title in 11 seasons, despite 아스널's 2–0 win at 미들즈브러. 웨스트브로미치 앨비언 are relegated despite a 2–1 away win over already relegated 선덜랜드. 레스터 시티 seal promotion to the Premier League with a 2–0 win over Brighton.
웨스트햄 유나이티드 manager Glenn Roeder is hospitalised with a suspected stroke; director of football Trevor Brooking is placed in charge of the first team until Roeder is well enough to resume control.

아스널 suffer a huge blow to their double hopes, as they surrender a 2–0 lead in their game-in-hand to draw 2–2 with Bolton at the Reebok Stadium – well and truly shifting the title race in 맨체스터 유나이티드 's favour with three games to go.

포츠머스 defeated Rotherham 3–2 to win the Division One championship and gain promotion to the Premier League for the first time since the league's inception. Apart from the 1987–88 season , they have not played top division football since the 1950s. On the same day, Alan Shearer receives the Premier League "Player of the Decade" award at a PFA ceremony.
Glenn Roeder's illness is diagnosed as a brain tumour which will be operated upon shortly.

선덜랜드, without a point since January and win since December, end the month, and 웨스트브로미치 앨비언, with only six wins in their first top division campaign for nearly 20 years, end April with their relegation battle lost. 웨스트햄 유나이티드 complete the Premier League bottom three but their survival bid is still very much alive as they are posing a threat to 볼턴 원더러스, 버밍엄 시티, 풀럼, 애스턴 빌라 and a 리즈 유나이티드 team who began the season among the teams expected to challenge for the title but are now battling relegation as well as huge debts.
